RUPARAMYASRI ALAMANDA Full Stack Developer | React.js | Node.js | JavaScript | Python | MongoDB | SQL | Nearly 4 Years of Experience Hyderabad, India | +91-8639246115 | ruparamyasri6115@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/ruparamyasri

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Full Stack Developer with nearly 4 years of experience building and maintaining scalable, secure, and high- performance web applications using React.js and Node.js. Experienced in developing multi-tenant web architectures, designing RESTful APIs, and integrating third-party services. Delivered a 30% reduction in API response times through performance optimization, caching (Redis), rate limiting, and SQL/NoSQL query tuning. Proficient in CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab CI, Docker-based deployments, and AWS (S3, EC2). Follows Agile development methodology with a strong focus on clean, maintainable code, security (JWT, OTP, VAPT), and application scalability. Leverages AI tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and ChatGPT — to accelerate development workflows and reduce delivery cycle time by 25%.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS

Frontend: React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Redux Backend: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI (Python) Databases: SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Query Writing, NoSQL APIs & Integration: REST APIs, WebSockets, Third-Party API Integration, Postman Architecture: Multi-Tenant Web Applications, Microservices-based Architecture, Scalable System Design CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, AWS (S3, EC2), Git, GitHub Auth & Security: JWT, OTP-based Authentication, VAPT, Application Security Performance: Redis Caching, Rate Limiting, API Optimization, Query Tuning Testing & Quality: Manual / Functional Testing, API Testing (Postman), Debugging, Code Reviews Methodology: Agile, Cross-functional Collaboration, Clean Code Practices AI Dev Tools: Claude Code (Anthropic), GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT (OpenAI)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Software Developer Enmovil Solutions Pvt Ltd | Hyderabad, India

Jan 2023 – Present

Developed and maintained full-stack web applications using React.js and Node.js, delivering a 30% improvement in API response times across production environments.

Designed and implemented multi-tenant web architectures, enabling secure, isolated data environments for multiple clients within a single application instance.

Built and consumed RESTful APIs and integrated third-party services across application layers, ensuring reliable and secure data flows.

Architected real-time features using WebSockets, sustaining 100+ concurrent user sessions with zero performance degradation.

Wrote clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices, conducting code reviews and functional testing to maintain high quality standards.

Managed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab CI to automate build, test, and deployment processes, reducing release cycle time and human error.

Troubleshot, debugged, and upgraded existing systems to resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues proactively.

Implemented Redis caching and rate limiting strategies to ensure application performance and stability under high-load conditions.

Optimized SQL Server and MongoDB queries, improving data retrieval performance and overall system throughput significantly.

Ensured application security and scalability through JWT/OTP-based authentication and VAPT-driven vulnerability remediation.

Designed and deployed multi-tenant-ready Node.js backend APIs, capable of handling high-volume concurrent requests without latency spikes.

Collaborated cross-functionally with product and QA teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver features on schedule.

• Accelerated development using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and ChatGPT — reducing development cycle time

by 25%.

Tech Stack: React.js · Node.js · Express.js · FastAPI · SQL Server · MongoDB · MySQL · Redis · WebSockets · JWT · jQuery · Jenkins · GitLab CI · Docker · AWS · Git · Multi-Tenant Architecture · REST APIs

KEY PROJECTS

RFQ & Vendor Bidding System

Built a multi-tenant RFQ platform enabling multiple vendor organisations to participate in real-time bidding with live updates via WebSockets.

Developed an automated bid ranking algorithm, reducing manual review effort and accelerating procurement decisions.

Designed a scalable Node.js backend with rate limiting and caching, handling high-volume concurrent bid submissions without latency.

Bajaj – Shipment Management System

Built a centralized shipment management platform to digitize and automate export workflows, reducing manual operational effort.

Developed responsive React.js interfaces improving usability and streamlining shipment tracking and reporting for operations teams.

Designed Node.js REST APIs and SQL Server data models to manage shipment data pipelines and automate workflow processes.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Reduced API response times by 30% through targeted backend optimizations and query restructuring in a live production environment.

Sustained 100+ concurrent WebSocket connections with zero downtime by engineering a robust real-time architecture.

Successfully delivered multi-tenant application features supporting multiple client organizations with fully isolated, secure data environments.

Streamlined deployments by implementing Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines, eliminating manual release steps and reducing deployment errors.

Strengthened platform security via OTP authentication and VAPT-driven fixes, achieving compliant, vulnerability- free production deployments.

EDUCATION

M.Sc. in Mathematics CGPA: 9.4 / 10 C.R. Reddy College (Autonomous, Affiliated to ANU) | 2022 Relevant: Data Structures, Algorithms, Statistical Computing, Probability & Logic

B.Sc. in Mathematics CGPA: 9.67 / 10 St. Theresa's College, Adikavi Nannaya University | 2020

CERTIFICATIONS

Full Stack Development Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies | React.js · Node.js · MongoDB · SQL · Python · REST APIs

2022 – 2023
